MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Reproduction? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Reproduction.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Reproduction.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Reproduction.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Reproduction.

4. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Ecology and Ecosystems? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Burning crop residue every week

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Record keeping in aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Record keeping in aquaculture.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Record keeping in aquaculture.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Record keeping in aquaculture.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Record keeping in aquaculture.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish feeds and feeding? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish feeds and feeding.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish feeds and feeding.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish feeds and feeding.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fish feeds and feeding.

9. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.

11. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Only water vapour

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conservation of marine and freshwater environments? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Blue Economy and Marine Entrepreneurship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Fish Reproduction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
